p: Verb - Qal - Perfect - first person common singular
Conjunctive waw | Verb - Piel - Conjunctive perfect - third person masculine singular
Verb - Hifil - Perfect - third person feminine singular
Verb - Piel - Participle - masculine singular construct
d: to trench; by implication, to throw forth; to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop)
j: break down, cast out, destroy, dig.
r: a primitive root; also denominative from H7023 (קִיר)
